Sample Test Turnaround Times

Source: R/test_turnaround_samp.R
test.turnaround.samp.Rd

Draws n samples from the test turnaround time distribution for the specified TTIQ scenario or custom configuration.

Usage

test.turnaround.samp(n, the.scenario, scenario_config = NULL)

Arguments

n

Integer. Number of samples to draw.

the.scenario

Character. Built-in scenario name: "optimal", "partial", or "baseline". Ignored if scenario_config is provided.

scenario_config

A scenario_config object created by create_scenario_config. If provided, the.scenario is ignored.

Value

Numeric vector of test turnaround times in days.

Details

Test turnaround time is the delay from sample collection to result notification. This varies by testing capacity and scenario.
